PR_metadata.body:
## Result
Proves the exact k601 target: the product of the two ordinary focal-pedal distance sums is constant for odd-period billiards in the source's nondegenerate nested-confocal-ellipse setting. Includes primitive star/winding classes and odd repetitions.

## Proof and attribution
Uses Stachel's published canonical parametrization and classical Jacobi addition/zeta identities. The all-odd-N argument telescopes cyclic correlations; no finite experiment substitutes for proof. No novelty, priority, human-peer-review, even-period or hyperbolic-caustic claim.

## Independent review
A separate full adversarial review passed the unchanged frozen proof, SHA-256 `09bfb91289e683809e71a668e020c1d37f8f99f717e3658d1cc80268fe55f147`. Review SHA-256 `872c4c373d6b644cd7d994f3f549536e08d878c20e21d820c3f9dce34f87a4a3`; independent controls include 3,609 exact assertions and 8,938 numerical diagnostics, labeled separately. The source table is unchanged between arXiv v11 and the published edition. PR110's k603 antipedal equality is a different target and not an input.

## Tracking
One substantive author turn, 1/5. Intended QUEUE status: claimed_solved, meaning a separately reviewed claim rather than a certified discovery. Only this target's row is updated. Full source PDFs, screenshots and extracted text are omitted; primary links and source hashes are provided. Draft only; no merge or release.
